items.title: Nine killed in South Florida business jet crash
items.feedTitle: Woman identifies daughter, 20, as one of the pilots on jet that crashed in Florida
items.summary: A business jet crashed near a busy roadway in Palm Beach County on Sunday, killing all nine people on board, including a 20-year-old co-pilot. The aircraft departed from Austin, Texas, bound for the Bahamas. Evidence suggests parts of the plane broke apart before impact during heavy thunderstorm conditions. The crash occurred in a heavily populated area and erupted into flames upon impact.

items.title: Multiple killed in Monterey County shooting near beach
items.feedTitle: Monterey County shooting: Multiple killed, several injured after shooting near Moss Landing State Beach, CA authorities say
items.summary: A shooting near Moss Landing State Beach in Monterey County, California resulted in multiple deaths and several injuries. Authorities responded to the incident near Jetty Road but details on the exact casualty count and motive remain under investigation. The shooting occurred in a recreational area popular with beachgoers.

items.title: Missing Utah teenager found safe in Oregon
items.feedTitle: Utah girl missing for more than 500 days found in Oregon; FBI says ‘gore groups’ suspected
items.summary: A Utah girl missing for over 500 days was found safe in Oregon. The FBI suspects involvement of 'gore groups'—online communities focused on extreme content. The case had sparked a major search operation across multiple states. The teenager's recovery marks a significant development in a widely-publicized missing persons case.

items.title: Senator Chris Murphy hospitalized after suffering stroke
items.feedTitle: Connecticut Sen. Chris Murphy is in the hospital after having a stroke, his office says
items.summary: Connecticut Senator Chris Murphy, 53, was hospitalized after experiencing numbness in his arm while attending his son's hockey game on Saturday. His chief of staff confirmed the stroke diagnosis. Murphy represents Connecticut in the U.S. Senate and serves on several key committees. His condition and recovery timeline remain to be disclosed.

stlouis.title: Missouri AG says police chief contract could be reconsidered
stlouis.feedTitle: Missouri AG says she heard of push to keep St. Louis police chief weeks before emergency vote, and his contract could get a redo
stlouis.summary: Missouri's Attorney General says she learned weeks in advance about efforts to extend St. Louis police chief's contract through an emergency vote. She indicated the contract decision could be revisited or redone. The statement suggests potential procedural concerns about how the contract extension was handled by the police board. This development comes amid ongoing scrutiny of the department's leadership.

stlouis.title: St. Louis area early voting surges versus 2022
stlouis.feedTitle: Early voting surges in St. Louis area compared to 2022
stlouis.summary: Early voting in the St. Louis area has seen a significant surge compared to 2022 midterm levels as voters prepare for the 2026 election. The increase reflects heightened engagement in the region ahead of Election Day. Data shows notably higher participation in advance voting compared to four years prior.

stlouis.title: Disability rights advocate highlights curbside voting access
stlouis.feedTitle: ‘You matter’: Disability rights advocate illuminates curbside voting, accessibility in St. Louis
stlouis.summary: A disability rights advocate in St. Louis has drawn attention to curbside voting as a critical accessibility option in the midterm elections. The advocate emphasizes that accessible voting methods affirm that "you matter" to voters with mobility challenges. The push comes as communities work to ensure equitable participation in the electoral process.

items.title: Russian bombing kills 26 at Ukraine aid center
items.feedTitle: Russian bombing kills 26 people at Ukraine aid centre, Kyiv says
items.summary: At least 26 people were killed when Russian forces dropped nine 3,000-kilogram aerial bombs on a village in southern Ukraine that housed an aid distribution center. Local officials report additional people remain missing from the attack. The strike represents a significant escalation in civilian targeting. Ukraine has condemned the attack as evidence Russia does not want de-escalation.

items.title: Oil prices fall on Iran diplomatic breakthrough hopes
items.feedTitle: Oil price falls amid hope of a breakthrough to end Iran war
items.summary: Brent crude dropped more than 6.5% to $105.55 per barrel—the lowest level in over two weeks—amid renewed hopes for a US-Iran ceasefire agreement. New diplomatic talks between Iran and mediators, condensed into an accelerated timeline, have eased concerns about further Middle East conflict. The price decline reflects investor optimism about potential de-escalation before the US midterms.

items.title: Russian oil refinery fire visible from satellite imagery
items.feedTitle: Major Russian Oil Hub on Fire After Strike, NASA Data Show
items.summary: Major Russian oil hub caught fire following an attack, with NASA satellite data documenting the blaze. Ukraine has resumed strikes on Russian refineries despite earlier pledges to pause operations. The attack underscores continued military pressure on energy infrastructure in the conflict.

items.title: Spain train crash kills 69; international casualties reported
items.feedTitle: Spain train crash: US, Japan and Canada citizens among dead, authorities say
items.summary: A deadly train crash in Spain killed 69 people, including citizens from the United States, Japan, and Canada. Among the dead were four Americans and one Canadian, as well as a Cambridge scientist. Spanish authorities are investigating the cause of the collision. The incident marks one of Spain's deadliest rail disasters in years.

items.title: Massive fire breaks out at Visakhapatnam oil refinery
items.feedTitle: Massive fire breaks out at oil refinery in India's Visakhapatnam
items.summary: A major fire erupted at HPCL's oil refinery in Visakhapatnam, India, following an explosion. The blaze sent thick smoke over the industrial area and created a significant emergency response. Authorities worked to contain the fire and assess damage. The incident highlights ongoing industrial safety concerns at major petroleum facilities.

items.title: Delhi air quality plunges to 'very poor' for first time
items.feedTitle: Air quality of Delhi slips to ‘very poor’ for first time this winter, Stage 2 of GRAP invoked
items.summary: Delhi's air quality index (AQI) reached 324—classified as 'very poor'—for the first time this winter, prompting authorities to invoke Stage 2 of the Graded Response Action Plan (GRAP). The deterioration from 'poor' (261) occurred in a single day. Measures include enhanced parking fees, staggered office timings, and additional metro trips to discourage private vehicle use.

items.title: Three Bengaluru techies drown at Gokarna beach
items.feedTitle: 3 Bengaluru techies drown after being swept away by waves at Gokarna beach
items.summary: Three people from Bengaluru drowned after being swept away by waves at Gokarna beach. The tourists were caught off guard by strong currents in the Arabian Sea. The incident underscores risks posed by unpredictable ocean conditions at popular beach destinations. Beach safety and warning systems remain under scrutiny.

items.title: Amit Shah counters infiltrator voting claims with data
items.feedTitle: '3 crore Bangladeshi infiltrators don't exist on voters' list': Amit Shah counters Rahul's anti-SIR pitch
items.summary: Home Minister Amit Shah challenged opposition claims about voter irregularities, stating that more than 40% of alleged 'Bangladeshi infiltrators' cited by critics do not appear in state voter files. Shah dared Rahul Gandhi to debate the issue in Parliament. The statement addresses ongoing political tensions over the Systematic Immigrant Registration (SIR) controversy.

immigration.title: USCIS ends automatic work permit extensions effective immediately
immigration.feedTitle: Confirmed by USCIS: Automatic Extension of Work Permits by Up to 540 Days Ends, and What Renewing Workers Need to Do
immigration.summary: USCIS has confirmed that automatic extensions of work permits (EAD/Form I-766) by up to 540 days have ended—finalized and in effect as of the Trump administration rule. Workers with pending EAD renewals must now act to maintain continuous work authorization or risk gaps in legal status. The change significantly affects employment-based immigrants, particularly H-1B visa holders and dependents.

immigration.title: DHS proposes ending deference to prior H-1B approvals
immigration.feedTitle: Removing Deference to Prior USCIS Determinations of Eligibility
immigration.summary: The Department of Homeland Security has proposed (not finalized) removing 8 CFR 214.1(c)(5), which currently grants deference to prior USCIS approvals when extending H-1B, L-1, and other Form I-129 petitions. If enacted, the rule would require each extension be evaluated de novo, increasing denial risk for renewals. Indian nationals—who comprise roughly 70% of H-1B beneficiaries—would face disproportionate impact, per USCIS data analysis.

immigration.title: November visa bulletin shows modest green card date movement
immigration.feedTitle: November Visa Bulletin brings new Green Card filing dates: Who can apply now?
immigration.summary: The November 2026 visa bulletin, released by the State Department (finalized and current), shows continued use of Dates for Filing charts for most categories. Family-sponsored visas advanced by one year; EB-3 dates for India show progress while EB-2 remains unchanged. The modest movement reflects ongoing green card processing backlogs, particularly affecting Indian nationals in the EB-2 category (91% of backlog per USCIS data).

items.title: Dow rises 500 points as oil plunges on Iran peace hopes
items.feedTitle: Dow pops 500 points, oil tumbles on hopes of a US-Iran peace deal
items.summary: U.S. stock markets rallied with the Dow gaining over 500 points as crude oil prices tumbled more than 7% on optimism about US-Iran diplomatic talks. Brent crude fell to $105.55, its lowest in over two weeks. The recovery reflects investor relief from geopolitical tensions ahead of midterm elections. Tech stocks and broader indices also benefited from the energy sector weakness.

items.title: Reliance Industries powers Sensex rally by 1,233 points
items.feedTitle: Reliance powers 1,233-point Sensex rally
items.summary: The Indian stock market's Sensex surged 1,233 points to a seven-week high, driven primarily by an 11.6% jump in Reliance Industries following strong Q2 earnings. Nifty topped 23,400 as markets extended a three-day rally. The broad-based momentum reflects optimism about corporate profitability and reflects the strongest profit growth in 12 quarters for the index.

items.title: Marvell, Lumentum announce $115 billion merger deal
items.feedTitle: Marvell Could Be Making a $115 Billion Mistake With Lumentum Purchase
items.summary: Marvell Technology and Lumentum announced a major $115 billion merger to combine chip and optical connectivity capabilities for AI infrastructure. The deal aims to capitalize on surging data center demand for AI computing. However, analysts question whether the valuation can generate adequate returns given current AI spending scrutiny and potential market saturation concerns.

items.title: Anthropic reports $17B quarterly revenue ahead of IPO
items.feedTitle: Anthropic posts $17B quarterly revenue but losses continue in fresh IPO filing
items.summary: AI company Anthropic disclosed $17 billion in projected quarterly revenue—a 1,100% surge—as it prepares for a public offering. However, the company reported significant losses and negative cash flow, with net losses totaling $104 billion in 2026. Analysts warn a junk credit rating may follow the IPO, complicating future fundraising for the money-burning AI firm.

items.title: North Korea blamed for $6.3 billion Binance crypto hack
items.feedTitle: Binance customers withdraw more than $4.6 billion after crypto heist
items.summary: The FBI identified North Korean hackers as the culprit behind a record $6.3 billion theft from cryptocurrency exchange Binance—the largest crypto heist in history. Binance said it would cover customer losses and has located approximately $3 billion in affected assets. The hack prompted massive customer withdrawals exceeding $4.6 billion as confidence in the exchange wavered.

Watch: midterm election results on Tuesday (which could shift policy for AI spending and tariffs), tech earnings (Apple, Palantir), and whether oil gains hold if peace talks stall.

cards.title: Work Permit Uncertainty Just Got Real
cards.insight: If you hold an H-1B visa or EAD (employment-based work permit), automatic extensions that once bought you 540 days of breathing room have ended. Your renewal must now be filed *before* your current authorization expires, or you risk a gap in legal work status. Indian nationals face the steepest risk, as they dominate the H-1B and EB-2 green card queues.
cards.takeaway: File your EAD renewal *now* if expiry is within 6 months. Consult an immigration attorney about the proposed deference rule change—your next H-1B extension could face tougher scrutiny.

cards.title: Oil Crashes, Your Paycheck Might Not
cards.insight: Crude prices fell 6.5% in two days on peace talks optimism, yet airline, gas, and food prices rarely fall as fast as oil does. Employers won't immediately cut costs saved from lower energy; they typically pocket the margin first. Don't count on immediate relief at the pump or grocery store.
cards.takeaway: Lock in any variable-rate debt refinancing while rates reflect oil weakness. Build a 2–3 month emergency fund before energy prices stabilize or geopolitical tensions flare again.

cards.title: Crypto Contagion: Not Your Keys, Not Your Coins
cards.insight: The $6.3 billion Binance hack—the largest in crypto history—shows that even the world's largest exchange can't guarantee asset safety. Customers faced automatic withdrawal freezes and uncertainty despite Binance's promise to cover losses. Centralized exchanges remain counterparty risk, no matter how large.
cards.takeaway: If you hold crypto, move non-trading positions to self-custody (hardware wallet). If you must use an exchange, keep only amounts you're willing to lose or that you're actively trading.

cards.title: Midterms Could Reshape Your AI Job Prospects
cards.insight: Congress controls H-1B visa caps, visa lottery rules, and AI regulation. A shift in party control could tighten visa sponsorship (particularly targeting Indian workers) or loosen it. Simultaneously, proposed rules ending 'deference' to prior H-1B approvals add uncertainty even before any new law passes.
cards.takeaway: If you're in an AI or tech role on a visa or seeking sponsorship, document your value and performance now. Start exploring whether you'd qualify for green card sponsorship or whether a green card timeline is viable in your current company.

ai.title: Anthropic reports $17 billion revenue surge before IPO
ai.feedTitle: Anthropic Reveals $17 Billion in Revenue as I.P.O. Approaches
ai.summary: AI startup Anthropic disclosed $17 billion in revenue for the first nine months of 2026—a 1,100% increase—as it prepares for a highly anticipated IPO. The company also reported substantial losses, with net losses exceeding $100 billion annually and R&D spending that surpassed Microsoft's. The IPO will test investor appetite for AI companies with massive burn rates and uncertain profitability timelines.

ai.title: New York Times sues Brave browser over content scraping
ai.feedTitle: New York Times and other outlets sue web browser Brave over alleged content scraping
ai.summary: The New York Times filed suit against privacy-focused web browser Brave, alleging the company scraped copyrighted content and unlawfully distributed it to AI companies including Anthropic and Perplexity. The lawsuit raises critical questions about copyright liability in AI model training. Brave's scraping practices highlight ongoing legal battles over AI training data sourcing.

ai.title: Anthropic imposes restrictions on Claude game cloning
ai.feedTitle: Anthropic clamps down on Claude’s AI video game clones
ai.summary: Anthropic added usage rules prohibiting Claude Code from recreating existing commercial video games. The policy aims to limit copyright infringement and IP violations in AI-generated content. However, analysts argue such restrictions face enforcement challenges and will not significantly slow broader AI content copying, as other models lack equivalent safeguards.

ai.title: 42AI emerges from stealth with behavioral world model
ai.feedTitle: 42AI comes out of stealth with $62.5M and a world model that can ‘predict human behavior’
ai.summary: AI startup 42AI unveiled a behavioral world model claiming the ability to predict human decisions before they occur, even in novel situations. The company raised $62.5 million in seed funding for the technology. The model represents an emerging category of AI systems designed to forecast and simulate human behavior, raising potential privacy and ethical concerns.

ai.title: OpenAI merges ChatGPT Chat and Work tabs into single app
ai.feedTitle: OpenAI is finally merging ChatGPT’s Chat and Work tabs
ai.summary: OpenAI announced plans to consolidate ChatGPT's separate Chat and Work tabs into a unified interface. Users' usage allocations will draw from a shared pool after the consolidation. The change aims to simplify the user experience but also reflects OpenAI's efforts to streamline product complexity as it competes with other AI assistants in the market.
